categories.main_business_segments: Meitu, Inc. operates primarily in four business segments: Photo, video and design products; Solutions for beauty industry; Advertising; and Others. The Photo, video and design products segment is the core and fastest-growing segment, driven by subscription and in-app purchases. Solutions for beauty industry include skin analysis services, ERP solutions, and cosmetic supply chain management. Advertising revenue is generated mainly through programmatic and performance-based ads within Meitu's platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AI technologies, including GenAI and large vision models, to enhance photo and video editing features and productivity tools. It employs scalable R&D and engineering infrastructure to rapidly develop and iterate products. Key AI-powered features include AI Squish, AI Hair, AI Wardrobe, and AI product image generation tailored for vertical e-commerce scenarios. The company also integrates cloud computing and inference-related computing power to support its services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Meitu serves individual consumers and business users globally, focusing on users of photo and video editing applications and productivity tools. It also serves cosmetic retailers and distributors through its beauty industry solutions. The advertising segment targets advertisers seeking placements on Meitu's platforms. The company’s global user base includes markets in Mainland China and international regions, with a significant portion of paying subscribers and MAUs outside Mainland China.
categories.geographic_coverage: Meitu operates primarily in Mainland China and international markets including Southeast Asia, the United States, the United Kingdom, South Korea, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, and Vietnam. Its headquarters are in Xiamen, China, with principal business operations in Hong Kong and subsidiaries in the Cayman Islands, BVI, and the US. The company has localized teams in regions such as the US West Coast and Sydney to support global expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Meitu operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the digital content and software supply chain. It develops and operates photo, video, and design applications, provides SaaS solutions for the beauty industry, and offers advertising services. The company also manufactures smart hardware products related to AI skin analysis. It acts as a principal in subscription and content licensing transactions and as an agent in advertising agency services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on 'Productivity and Globalisation,' emphasizing AI-driven innovation in photo, video, and design products and productivity tools. The company invests heavily in R&D, particularly in AI technologies such as GenAI and large vision models, to enhance product features and shorten development cycles. It aims to achieve world-class effects in vertical scenarios and expand its global user base through localized product development and social media amplification. The company also pursues synergy between its beauty SaaS business and minority investments.
categories.revenue_model: Meitu generates revenue primarily through subscription fees and in-app purchases for its photo, video, and design products. It also earns revenue from advertising placements, including programmatic and performance-based ads, and influencer marketing services. The beauty industry segment generates revenue from sales of cosmetic products, SaaS subscriptions, and smart hardware sales. Licensing fees for content and rebates from advertising platforms also contribute to revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Meitu positions itself as a leader in the photo and video editing industry with a large and growing user base and strong AI capabilities. Its comprehensive product ecosystem and technological innovation provide competitive advantages over peers who may rely on single-feature offerings. The company leverages its scale for operational leverage and global expansion, aiming to maintain top app store rankings in multiple countries.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Meitu reported revenue of RMB 3.34 billion in 2024, a 23.9% increase year-on-year, with net profit attributable to owners rising 112.8% to approximately RMB 805 million. The company’s gross margin improved to 68.7%, driven by the high-margin photo, video, and design products segment. Monthly active users reached approximately 266 million with 12.61 million paying subscribers, reflecting steady growth and increasing monetization. The company maintains a low gearing ratio of 2.04% and strong liquidity with nearly RMB 3 billion in cash and liquid assets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Meitu emphasizes its unique fusion of art and technology to deliver high-performance photo, video, and design products with advanced AI features tailored for vertical use cases. Its large user base enables rapid identification and validation of user needs, facilitating successful product launches and iterations. The company’s globalized approach combines localized product development with social media amplification to drive user growth. Its comprehensive feature ecosystem and scalable R&D capabilities differentiate it from competitors relying on single-feature advantages.
